# Kordran

> Supplier cost verification and resolution for industrial manufacturers.

Kordran helps manufacturers identify pricing discrepancies, resolve supplier issues, and prevent repeat charges. The work covers supplier pricing and contract reconciliation, unsupported or incorrectly implemented charges, and commercial follow-through after a finding.

An example price comparison on the homepage is hypothetical. It is not a customer result, and a pricing difference is not itself a recovery.

Kordran Inc. is not a law firm, customs broker, lender, or regulated financial institution.
